The '''DH-18A blaster pistol''' was a ranged prototype weapon produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] in an attempt to update the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This pistol is one of the weapons a player may obtain with Galactic Civil War Tokens in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
